Disputed returns; the Electoral Commission awarded all 4 votes to Hayes 8-7 These are the returns certified by Florida's canvassing board; the result was disputed and decided by the Electoral Commission. This state's 1876 return was disputed and the site follows the returns certified by the state's canvassing board (see docs/data/votes-historic.md). The Tribune Almanac 1878, p. 60, prints Hayes 23,849 and Tilden 22,923 without saying which return it reports, so its figures are not used for this state.
